rules.single: D2S verdict of twin seed `pair` alone (GATE)
rules.mean: GATE on the ensemble mean of each gate quantity
rules.margin: primary: GATE with each quantity moved against acceptance by one sample sd (steering: mean(hot_prb_reduction)-sd >= 5 AND mean(throughput_loss)+sd <= 5; energy: mean(energy_saving)-sd >= 5 AND mean(remaining_prb_increase)+sd <= 30)
